what: A coordinated evening community hospitality gathering in the town hall great hall at eighteen on day 1, with large bread catering and lantern lighting. Builder coordinated supplies and lighting; innkeeper paid for catering, deposited bread, and will escort me; baker supplied the bread. Secretary identifies freight with the gathering and knowingly reserves my attendance and escort. I have now been invited, but the programme and any further purpose remain undisclosed.
